label: Treasure Hunter
tooltip: Coffer and carrot lines, Treasure Hunt, and Carrot Hunt.

enable_shared_maps.label: Share maps with the community
enable_shared_maps.tooltip:
On: while in Occult Crescent, download shared carrot/coffer pads and pot timers, and anonymously upload what you see. Built-in pads still work if download fails.
Off: no download or upload — built-in maps and local pot timing only.

draw_line_to_bronze_chests.label: Lines to bronze coffers
draw_line_to_bronze_chests.tooltip:
On: while out of combat, draw a brown line to nearby bronze coffers.
Off: no line.

draw_line_to_silver_chests.label: Lines to silver coffers
draw_line_to_silver_chests.tooltip:
On: while out of combat, draw a silver line to nearby silver coffers.
Off: no line.

draw_line_to_carrots.label: Lines to carrots
draw_line_to_carrots.tooltip:
On: while out of combat, draw a green line to nearby carrots.
Off: no line.

return_to_base_camp_after_hunt.label: Cast Return after hunt
return_to_base_camp_after_hunt.tooltip:
On: cast Return after Treasure Hunt or Carrot Hunt finishes.
Off: do not cast Return when the hunt ends.
Loop Carrot Hunt: Return waits until looping stops.

loop_carrot_hunt.label: Loop Carrot Hunt
loop_carrot_hunt.tooltip:
On: skip empty pads; after each Fortune Carrot, check every pad again. If a full pass finds none, keep checking until Stop or you run out of carrots.
Off: one pass, then finish.

play_sound_on_hunt_complete.label: Play sound when Treasure Hunt finishes

hunt_complete_sound.label: Hunt finished sound
hunt_complete_sound.tooltip: MP3 from the plugin Sounds folder. Click a name to preview.
hunt_complete_sound.open_folder: Open sound folder — drop MP3s here to add your own.

cast_treasure_sight_during_hunt.label: Cast Treasure Sight during hunt
cast_treasure_sight_during_hunt.tooltip:
On: cast at hunt start and on the interval below. Stops early if Sight says nothing is left.
Off: do not cast Sight during the hunt.

hunt_max_level.label: Max coffer level
hunt_max_level.tooltip: Skip coffers whose nearby enemies are above this level. 50 = no limit.

hunt_min_bronze_percent.label: Min bronze fill to auto-hunt (%)
hunt_min_bronze_percent.tooltip:
With Treasure Sight: start when bronze fill is at least this % of 30 — or when silver meets its %.
Used by General → Auto treasure hunt and Mob Farmer → Treasure Hunt on a timer.
Without Sight: Illegal Mode uses the built-in map and ignores this.

hunt_min_silver_percent.label: Min silver fill to auto-hunt (%)
hunt_min_silver_percent.tooltip:
With Treasure Sight: start when silver fill is at least this % of 8 — or when bronze meets its %.
Used by General → Auto treasure hunt and Mob Farmer → Treasure Hunt on a timer.
Without Sight: Illegal Mode uses the built-in map and ignores this.

empty_pad_trust_distance.label: Empty pad check distance
empty_pad_trust_distance.tooltip: How close (yalms) before treating a pad as empty and moving on. Lower = walk closer (safer when coffers load late); higher = skip sooner.

skip_unsafe_treasure_windows.label: Skip dangerous weather / Ashkin
skip_unsafe_treasure_windows.tooltip:
On: pause Treasure Hunt on South Horn during Ashkin or other unsafe weather.
Off: keep hunting through those windows.

use_ninja_hide_on_dangerous_routes.label: Ninja Hide near strong enemies
use_ninja_hide_on_dangerous_routes.tooltip:
On: near a high-Knowledge enemy, swap to Ninja, Hide, and walk the last stretch. Stays on Ninja through the open so Hide is not dropped by a job swap next to the pack.
Off: do not use Hide for route threats.
Treasure Hunt, Carrot Hunt, and pot chest farm.

use_occult_sprint_while_hidden.label: Occult Sprint while Hidden
use_occult_sprint_while_hidden.tooltip:
On: while Hidden, switch to Phantom Thief and cast Occult Sprint.
Off: stay Hidden without Occult Sprint.

ninja_gearset_number.label: Ninja gearset number
ninja_gearset_number.tooltip: Gearset that equips Ninja (list number, starting at 1). 0 = do not swap — you must already be on Ninja.

knowledge_hide_offset.label: Hide vs enemies this many Knowledge above you
knowledge_hide_offset.tooltip: Hide when a nearby enemy's Knowledge is at least yours plus this. Higher = only stronger enemies. Negative = also weaker ones. Uses your real Knowledge, not synced South Horn. 0 = same Knowledge or higher.

knowledge_threat_enter_distance.label: Start Hide within (yalms)
knowledge_threat_enter_distance.tooltip: Start Hide when a dangerous enemy is this close. While mounted, starts 5 yalms earlier. A few crowded North Horn pads start Hide farther out automatically.

knowledge_threat_exit_distance.label: Keep Hide until farther than (yalms)
knowledge_threat_exit_distance.tooltip: Once Hide is on, keep it until enemies are farther than this.
